basic_info.name: Lioran Developer Solutions
basic_info.description: Lioran Developer Solutions (LDS) is an Indian developer infrastructure company building modern, high-performance tools for the next generation of software teams.Our mission is simple: Building India's Developer Infrastructure.We develop developer-first platforms that help startups, enterprises, and engineering teams build, deploy, and scale applications with speed, reliability, and simplicity.Our flagship product, LioranDB, is a high-performance NoSQL document database engineered for modern workloads. Built from the ground up with performance, scalability, and developer experience in mind, LioranDB is designed to power SaaS platforms, APIs, AI applications, and data-intensive systems.Beyond databases, we're building a complete ecosystem of developer infrastructure, including cloud services, API marketplaces, storage solutions, and tools that reduce complexity for developers and businesses.

basic_info.name: Wiroxa
basic_info.description: Wiroxa is a developer-focused technology company building tools that automate modern software workflows.Our mission is simple: remove repetitive work from development so builders can focus on creating real products.We design intelligent tools that help developers, startups, and engineering teams streamline tasks like commits, automation, and workflow management.Our ecosystem includes products like GitCommitter, an AI-powered commit automation tool designed to simplify development workflows and improve productivity.At Wiroxa, we believe the future of software development is driven by automation, intelligent tooling, and seamless developer experiences.We are building the infrastructure for the next generation of developer productivity.

basic_info.name: Undreamt
basic_info.description: Undreamt is an open-source technology organization focused on building modern developer tools, scalable infrastructure, and AI-powered systems for the next generation of software development.We create reliable, developer-first solutions that simplify workflows, improve productivity, and enable rapid innovation across backend engineering, automation, cloud-native technologies, and artificial intelligence.Our mission is rooted in:• Open-source collaboration• Clean and maintainable engineering• Performance and scalability• Developer experience• Continuous experimentation with emerging technologiesUndreamt believes in building practical technology with transparency, community involvement, and long-term impact. We aim to empower developers, startups, and technical communities through accessible and production-ready software.
